title: CodeChef: Biryani classes
description: Chef wants to learn how to make Biryani. A master chef takes `x` weeks to teach, charging `y` coins per week. Calculate total coins Chef needs.
constraints:
1 <= x, y <= 100
• Time: O(1) | Space: O(1)
starter_code:
def biryani_cost(x: int, y: int) -> int:
    pass
solution:
def biryani_cost(x: int, y: int) -> int:
    return x * y
explanation: Multiplies weeks by rate in O(1) time.
